about: Hand-computed agreement statistics (spec 041, 3.8.4 and 3.8.5). qwk cases give an observed matrix, rows side a and columns side b, with w = (i - j)^2 and E the outer product of the marginals over n. Every scorer has the ordinal levels low, mid, high; model marks a judge. split is the cases in order with each one's human rating (null: none), then out the cases outside every new metric; scores maps each scorer to its document, each case to its level index or, as a string, its unscored reason. A count is num/den over cases; a mean is num/den, computed as one binary64 division, or given as its bit pattern; breakdown is the whole exclusion count.

qwk.name: marginals whose product exceeds u64
qwk.arithmetic: each count is u64::MAX / 4; a row total times a column total exceeds u64, and the product is taken in u128: no overflow, a finite value.

qwk.name: every case on one level on both sides
qwk.arithmetic: rows (0, 3), columns (0, 3): E is 3 at (1, 1) and 0 elsewhere, so sum(w * E) = 0 and qwk is unknown.

cases.name: judges and human labels
cases.arithmetic: Judge against human labels: a (0, 0), b (2, 1), c (2, 2); d has no rating. exact 2/3, adjacent 3/3, mean |d| = (0 + 1 + 0) / 3. qwk: O = [[1,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,1,1]], sum(w * O) = 1, sum(w * E) = 5: 0.8; qwk has no per-case measure (3.11.1). Two judges: a (0, 0), b (2, 1), d (1, 1); c is unscored by j2: exact 2/3. A deterministic scorer in full agreement, a (0, 0), b (1, 1), c (2, 2): exact 1, qwk 1. Agreements with a model side are named under model/, after the deterministic ones.

cases.name: a side with no scores document
cases.arithmetic: j2 has no document: every statistic of j1_j2 is unknown, scores-missing.
